meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: croissance du chiffre d'affaires à taux de change constant
guidances.citation: For Fiscal 2027, the Company expects constant currency revenues to increase mid- to high-single digits to last year on a 52-week comparable basis, now centered around 6% to 7%, up from a range of 5% to 6% previously, reflecting better-than-expected second quarter results.

guidances.libelle: expansion de la marge opérationnelle à taux de change constant
guidances.citation: The Company now expects operating margin for Fiscal 2027 to expand approximately 80 to 100 basis points in constant currency, up from its prior outlook, driven primarily by gross margin expansion.

guidances.libelle: croissance du chiffre d'affaires à taux de change constant
guidances.citation: For the third quarter, the Company expects revenues to grow approximately low- to mid-single digits on a constant currency basis, centered around 3% to 4%.

guidances.libelle: expansion de la marge opérationnelle à taux de change constant
guidances.citation: Operating margin for the third quarter is expected to expand approximately 50 to 70 basis points in constant currency, with gross margin expansion more than offsetting higher marketing investments in the holiday period.
The Company's full year Fiscal 2027 tax rate is still expected to be in the range of approximately 21% to 22%.
The third quarter tax rate is expected to be approximately 23% to 24%.

guidances.libelle: dépenses d'investissement en pourcentage du chiffre d'affaires
guidances.citation: The Company continues to expect capital expenditures for Fiscal 2027 of approximately 4% to 5% of revenue.
